\[x^2 - xz + z^2 = \frac{1}{2}((x-z)^2 + x^2 + z^2),\]

Thus, the expression becomes:
\[(x^2 - xy + y^2)(x^2 - xz + z^2)(y^2 - yz + z^2) = \left(\frac{1}{2}((x-y)^2 + x^2 + y^2)\right) \left(\frac{1}{2}((x-z)^2 + x^2 + z^2)\right) \left(\frac{1}{2}((y-z)^2 + y^2 + z^2)\right).\]
